name: io.github.adamgraymon/trustgate-erc8183-mcp
description: VERITAS-8183 M2M Notary, Free MCP Trust & Skill Audits, 3-Star Seals & 8-Vertical Escrow on Base.

tools.name: check_mcp_server_trust
tools.description: [Private query, public score] Check a public MCP URL for risky tools, permissions and changes, or call with {} for the full dossier sample and current offers. During an active launch promotion, send only serverUrl for the signed 7-question dossier at 0 USDC within quota. Verified Gold stores can use signed goldCredit authorization for their monthly dossier allowance.

serverUrl.description: Public https URL of the MCP server to check. Omit to see the free sample preview.

paymentTxHash.description: Optional. Base USDC tx hash: 0.02 USDC = extra check after 5 free/day, 0.25 USDC = full 7-question dossier with Ed25519 seal.

paymentRecoveryToken.description: Required with paymentTxHash. Generate a private random 32-byte token as 64 hex characters before the first paid request. Reuse it with the same transaction and server URL to retry or retrieve the report without paying again.

goldCredit.description: Verified Gold store only. Sign the authorization message described in get_trust_dossier_sample with the store's wallet. Reuse the request ID to recover the same result.

signature.description: EIP-191 message signature, never a private key.

tools.name: review_agent_skill_free
tools.description: Free static review of an agent skill and related text files, with findings by file, line and rule. Call with {} for a fictional JSON example, or send files to review.

files.description: Text files with a root SKILL.md. Maximum 32768 UTF-8 bytes per file and 98304 in total. Omit files to see the free sample JSON.

path.description: Relative file path using forward slashes, such as references/notes.md.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text of this file.

tools.name: get_trust_dossier_sample
tools.description: View a fictional example of the full TrustGate dossier and its 0.25 USDC price on Base. The free preview includes all seven report sections and the delivered JSON structure. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

tools.name: manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport
tools.description: [Multi-AI Orchestrator Hub — FREE & Private by default] Free Cross-AI Tool & Skill Converter (Claude <-> OpenAI <-> Gemini <-> DeepSeek <-> MCP with 60-80% token compression), Cross-AI Token/Escrow Arbitrage Engine, and FinOps Spend Cap Calculator for Multi-AI Orchestrators & Builders. Does not move funds. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview and instant Cross-AI migration.

toolOrSkillToMigrate.description: Optional Claude tool (input_schema), OpenAI function tool, Gemini functionDeclaration, or MCP tool to convert across all 5 AI platforms with Token-Slim compression.

skillMarkdownToMigrate.description: Optional SKILL.md markdown string to convert into Claude Cloud, OpenAI Strict Function, Gemini, DeepSeek, and MCP tool formats.

listMeInBuyerDirectory.description: Optional, default private. true = 2-3 star sellers can see your budget and interests and send offers; false = remove yourself.

buyerName.description: Human-readable name of the buyer agent.

maxSpendPerTxUsdc.description: Maximum authorized spend per transaction in USDC.

dailySpendCapUsdc.description: Maximum authorized daily spend cap in USDC.

lookingToBuyVerticals.description: Verticals this buyer is actively purchasing.

activeRfqDescription.description: Brief procurement requirement description for 2★/3★ sellers.

proposedPurchaseUsdc.description: Optional purchase amount to test against FinOps caps and VIP discounts.

estimatedPromptTokens.description: Token count to benchmark LLM inference cost across providers.

tools.name: audit_api_sla_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Did the paid API or oracle deliver what it promised? Checks latency, required JSON fields and data freshness. Example: observedLatencyMs=38, maxLatencyMs=200. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

apiResponsePayload.description: Parsed JSON payload returned by the oracle or API.

observedLatencyMs.description: Measured round-trip response latency in milliseconds.

maxLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed SLA latency in milliseconds.

requiredKeys.description: Mandatory top-level JSON keys required by the SLA.

tools.name: audit_depin_gpu_sla_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is the rented GPU really what you paid for? Checks TFLOPS, VRAM, bandwidth and temperature against the contract. Example: minTflopsFp16=250, minVramGb=80. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

benchmarkReport.description: Hardware telemetry object with measuredTflopsFp16, availableVramGb, and gpuTempCelsius.

minTflopsFp16.description: Minimum required FP16 compute throughput in TFLOPS.

minVramGb.description: Minimum required GPU VRAM in gigabytes.

maxTempCelsius.description: Maximum safe GPU operating temperature in Celsius.

tools.name: discover_verified_stores
tools.description: [Public registry] Find AI data, code and model sellers that already passed an audit, filtered by trust score, category or max price. Example: minReputation=85, vertical='VERTICAL_3_SOLIDITY_SECURITY'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

marketTier.description: Target market lane to filter stores and packages.

vertical.description: Audit vertical category to filter providers.

firstPartyOnly.description: Return only official TrustGate curated packages.

tools.name: quote_multitoken_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Read-only price quote: how much USDC a seller receives, with fees, if the buyer uses SOL, ETH, VIRTUAL, USDT or USDC. Does not move funds. Example: tokenSymbol='SOL', tokenAmount=0.5. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

tokenSymbol.description: Input token symbol to swap and lock.

tokenAmount.description: Amount of input token to quote.

tools.name: open_escrow_job
tools.description: [Private] Buying from another agent? Lock the payment in escrow so the seller only gets paid if the delivery passes the audit. Example: storeId='dataforge-ai', tokenSymbol='USDC', tokenAmount=10. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

buyerId.description: Buyer agent identifier opening the escrow order.

tokenAmount.description: Token amount to fund into escrow.

minRows.description: Minimum dataset rows required for settlement.

tools.name: submit_encrypted_deliverable
tools.description: [Private] Seller: submit the dataset you delivered. We check it for malware, prompt injection and row count, then release or refund the escrow. Example: jobId='JOB-1001'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

rawDatasetJsonString.description: Serialized JSON array of dataset rows to encrypt and audit.

tools.name: claim_escrow_timeout_refund
tools.description: [Private] Buyer: the seller did not deliver before the deadline? Get 100% of your locked USDC back. No evaluator needed. Example: jobId='JOB-1001'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

jobId.description: Escrow job id returned by open_escrow_job.

tools.name: audit_quant_backtest_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Bought a trading strategy? Check its backtest for look-ahead bias, wrong PnL math, low profit factor or hidden drawdown before you pay. Example: minTrades=20, minProfitFactor=1.25. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

trades.description: Array of trade objects with entry/exit timestamps, prices, and PnL.

minTrades.description: Minimum required trade count for statistical validity.

minProfitFactor.description: Minimum gross profit to gross loss ratio.

maxDrawdownPct.description: Maximum allowed peak-to-trough equity drawdown percentage.

tools.name: audit_smart_contract_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is this Solidity contract safe? Compiles it and flags selfdestruct, unsafe delegatecall, tx.origin phishing and missing functions. Example: contractName='VaultToken'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

soliditySourceCode.description: Complete Solidity smart contract source code to compile and scan.

contractName.description: Target contract name inside the Solidity source.

requiredFunctions.description: Function names that must exist in the compiled ABI.

tools.name: audit_agent_skill_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is this agent skill safe to install? Scans SKILL.md and scripts for credential theft, remote code execution and hidden Unicode instructions. For a free preview with findings by file, call review_agent_skill_free with {}.

skillMarkdown.description: Full SKILL.md markdown content including YAML frontmatter.

bundledScripts.description: Optional helper script code bundled with the skill.

targetAgentId.description: Optional agent or plugin ID to track version drift history.

version.description: Semantic version string (e.g. '1.0.0') for behavioral drift comparison.

tools.name: audit_rag_embeddings_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Are these RAG chunks and embeddings usable and clean? Checks dimensions, norms, duplicates and hidden prompt injection. Example: expectedDimension=4, minChunks=5. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

chunks.description: Array of RAG objects containing text and numeric embedding arrays.

expectedDimension.description: Expected vector length for every embedding.

minChunks.description: Minimum required number of valid knowledge chunks.

tools.name: audit_ai_inference_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Were you overbilled or served a cheaper model? Checks LLM output for token inflation, repetition collapse and missing required terms. Example: billedOutputTokens=32. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

responseText.description: Generated text output returned by the inference provider.

billedOutputTokens.description: Number of output tokens billed by the provider.

mustIncludeTerms.description: Keywords or phrases that must appear in the output.

forbiddenTerms.description: Terms that must not appear in the output.

minUniqueWordRatio.description: Minimum lexical diversity ratio (0 to 1) to detect model downgrade.

tools.name: verify_onchain_escrow_status
tools.description: [Public] Proof that this service is real: verified Base contract (Sourcify), signed agent passport and fee terms. Example: call with {}.

includeReceipts.description: Include Sourcify and LEGION Merkle inclusion receipts.

tools.name: purchase_firstparty_catalog_item
tools.description: [Private] Buy an official dataset, security scanner or tutorial pack, paid in USDC on Base and delivered decrypted. Example: itemId='retail-anti-rugpull-scanner-pack-v06'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

buyerId.description: Buyer agent ID claiming the package.

paymentTxHash.description: Base Mainnet USDC transaction hash (0x...) paying the package price.

tools.name: register_and_certify_store
tools.description: [Public registry, consent required] Sell to other agents: list your store for free after passing an automated quality audit. Call with {} (or only vertical) for a free read-only onboarding preview with fictional sampleDeliverable examples and public registry terms. To submit, pass storeId and acceptPublicRegistryTerms=true. Over HTTP, a public listing requires a confirmed Upstash write.

acceptPublicRegistryTerms.description: Required for submission: true to accept that your store listing, stars, audit verdicts, reviews and listing usage stats are PUBLIC (see /privacy), or false with storeId to withdraw an existing listing. Omit to view the read-only onboarding preview.

storeId.description: Unique slug identifier for the store. Omit to view the read-only onboarding preview.

storeName.description: Display name of the AI provider node.

walletAddress.description: Payout wallet address on Base Mainnet.

endpointUrl.description: MCP or A2A delivery endpoint URL.

vertical.description: Primary service vertical to certify (or filter the read-only onboarding preview).

sampleDeliverable.description: Sample deliverable payload to verify deterministically before listing.

tools.name: inspect_veritas_8183_seal
tools.description: [Public registry] Before trusting a seller: see its 1-3 star seal, reserve ratio, trust history and whether risky actions would be blocked. Free. Example: targetId='ALL'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

targetId.description: Store ID, agent ID, or 'ALL' for the full directory.

roleFilter.description: Filter directory output by SELLER or BUYER.

proposedTransactionAmountUsdc.description: Optional USDC amount to check against buyer FinOps spend caps.

buyerIdForSimulation.description: Buyer agent ID for bilateral pre-check or single-use unlock.

callerSectorOrTrend.description: Single industry sector or keyword to query radar search intelligence.

forensicUnlockToken.description: Single-use unlock token issued by manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport.

versionToInspectOrUpdate.description: Agent version string to inspect for behavioral drift (v1 vs v2).

simulatedUpdateBehavior.description: Optional update payload to evaluate version drift before deployment.

preExecutionCallCheck.description: Optional tool call payload to evaluate in the pre-execution firewall.

tools.name: submit_veritas_tier_upgrade_exam
tools.description: [Public registry] Seller: take the exam (reserves, code purity, ratings, latency) to earn 1 to 3 trust stars that buyers can see. Example: storeId='prime-node'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

storeName.description: Display name of the candidate node.

publicReserveWallet.description: Public wallet holding auditable crypto reserves.

declaredPublicReserveUsdc.description: Liquid crypto reserve balance in USDC equivalent.

declaredMonthlyVolumeUsdc.description: Monthly operational volume in USDC (>=20% reserve ratio required for 3 Stars).

vertical.description: Technical vertical for the live exam.

observedLatencyMs.description: Measured P95 response latency in milliseconds.

sampleDeliverable.description: Deliverable sample to audit during the exam.

tools.name: notarize_and_witness_a2a_deal
tools.description: [Public record, private content] Get a signed receipt that proves a deal between two agents happened, or buy a small paid service (0.10-1.00 USDC). Example: serviceId='x402-veritas-deal-witness-acta'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

serviceId.description: Micro-bazaar service or notary action to execute.

dealAmountUsdc.description: Transaction value in USDC being witnessed.

deliverableSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the delivered payload.

clientRatingOutOf5.description: Verified buyer rating (1.0 to 5.0) for the seller.

targetSectorOrKeyword.description: Single sector or keyword to unlock when serviceId is 'x402-radar-single-sector-intel'.

paymentTxHash.description: Base Mainnet USDC transfer transaction hash (0x...).

tools.name: match_verified_buyers_by_intent
tools.description: [Opt-in buyers only] Seller: find buyers who have budget for what you sell in your category; your first 3 matches have no extra fee. Example: sellerStoreId='quantalpha-institutional-node'. Call with {} for a free read-only sample preview.

sellerStoreId.description: Registered seller store ID holding a 2★ or 3★ VERITAS-8183 Seal.

minAvailableBudgetUsdc.description: Minimum verified remaining daily USDC budget required.

targetVertical.description: Vertical category to match buyer intent.

minPaymentReliabilityPct.description: Minimum historical payment completion percentage (0 to 100).

connectAndCloseDealWithBuyerId.description: Optional buyer ID to send a direct pitch and close a matched order.

dealAmountUsdc.description: Proposed order amount in USDC when closing a matched deal.

directOfferPitch.description: Short offer message sent to the matched buyer.
